summary: telemetry-metrics drops remote file from unrelated GitHub account into C:\Windows\
details: telemetry-metrics is an unscoped package that impersonates @telemetry-js/telemetry (README badges and homepage point at the telemetry-js project, but this package is published under a different, unscoped name). lib/plugin-options.js, reachable through the exposed Control.plugin() API after require('telemetry-metrics'), fetches https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThoSuperstarDev/axios-http/main/lib/env/te.txt (a mutable main branch on a personal GitHub account unrelated to the telemetry-js publisher, with no version pin or hash verification) and writes the bytes to C:\Windows\1.txt via fs.writeFileSync. Staging attacker-controlled content fetched from a third-party mutable ref into a Windows system directory is a dropper pattern; whatever the file contains today can be changed by the third-party account holder at any time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
